items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Tubby Hall and his brother, Minor, I saw them playing drums when I was a kid

ctx.x: That's where the La Rocca Boys come from. So Tubby Hall and his brother, Minor, I saw them playing drums when I was a kid, you understand? And they are cousins to the Humphreys. Yeah, they are cousins to the Humphreys. Yeah, so I saw Happy, then I began to see Mud Carey, Jack Carey, two brothers. Then I began to attend the dances. I'd sneak away from home and borrow somebody's pants, long pants, you know, and sometimes we'd have to saw them down to my side one way or the other, and I'd go to these dances…
Where did you hear those? At the dances?
